The phone must be in the home network or connected through Tailscale.
column2: Das Handy muss im Heimnetz sein oder über Tailscale verbunden.

column1: To use the NVIDIA card: hs recipe immich --ask, answer yes.

column1: Turn it off again: hs recipe immich --ask, answer no.
